archive_input.selection: full canonical TRAIN identities from P1 and P7 only
archive_input.other_hh_passes: not loaded by the actual response execution; the pass{1..8} pattern is an archive-source description

source_af.raw_input_to_response: raw NativeObservation payload is accessed only after complete metadata/header gate

candidate_domain.q_semantics: scattering-location image pixel, never a TopHat center
candidate_domain.finer_off_grid_rule: Stage B is one fixed half-open [-2,2)^3 grid at 0.5 m around a qualified or provisional Stage-A inspection center

maps.noncoherent_summary: rank/median display only; no coincident-q or equal-peak requirement
maps.H_cache: forbidden; stream records/chunks and retain only owning panel accumulators
maps.common_scale_visualization: eight map visualizations on a common scale in dB

stage_a_rule.dilation: half one-metre coarse cell = 0.5 m per side; sampled uncertainty convention
stage_a_rule.common_box: all relevant discovery and confirmation panel supports fit the same one of 18 boxes
stage_a_rule.selection: maximum minimum containment margin, then lexicographic center tie-break
stage_a_rule.alternates: all common boxes and margins are emitted
stage_a_rule.boundary: outer coarse-boundary support, disjoint groups, or no common box is INCONCLUSIVE
stage_a_rule.context_rule: outside/inside response ratios are descriptive for all eight panels; any context-dominated label requires a separately reported panel-evidence rule and is not a prerequisite
stage_a_rule.roi_semantics: R=I conditional response-informed operational ROI; never surveyed/physical placement

stage_b_rule.offsets_m: [-2,2) sampled every 0.5 m in each axis

alias_and_psf.status: eight-panel PSF/alias/context diagnostics use separate maps and noncoherent group rank/median summaries
alias_and_psf.deterministic_reference: map-derived reference with deterministic tie-break; no refinement loop
alias_and_psf.offgrid_reference_sensitivity: eight half-cell corners with bounded local 3x3x3 BP; sampling sensitivity only
alias_and_psf.radial_sensitivity: only a labeled free-direction/roughly-one-m sensitivity; never fixed rho/alpha/zeta physics

qualification.status: conditional Stage-A/Stage-B response-informed ROI only; no measured fit release

work_ledger.term_definition: direct kernel/sample terms only; not exact FLOPs

resource_proposal.memory_note: streamed 512x434 complex128 kernel is about 3.6 MB; loaded P1/P7 response copies dominate peak RAM
resource_proposal.time_basis: conservative CPU extrapolation for NumPy streaming; not a measured runtime proof or manager-approved envelope

future_outputs: eight complex map arrays and common-scale MIP/slice figure
discovery/confirmation support and working-cube table around the qualified or provisional inspection center
panel-matched PSF/alias/context diagnostics around the qualified or provisional inspection center
raw/source 3x3 bridge report around the qualified or provisional inspection center
